metadata.title: Climate Intervention Role Classification Data
metadata.subtitle: Problem-layer mapping, not competition ranking
metadata.author: Master / inchacomusho / InchaComisho
metadata.framing: This dataset classifies climate intervention approaches by the problem layer they address, not by ranking them against each other. The central question is: which heat pathways and circulation systems does each approach actually engage?
metadata.caution: Scores (0–3) represent qualitative assessments of how strongly each approach engages each problem layer. They are not quantitative climate-model outputs. Uncertainty is high for all novel or large-scale interventions.
metadata.score_scale: 0 = not applicable or negligible, 1 = weak or indirect, 2 = moderate, 3 = strong or primary

input_control.label: Input-control measure
input_control.description: Reduces future heat input or radiative forcing
input_control.description_ja: 将来の熱入力や放射強制力を減らす

concentration_control.label: Concentration-control measure
concentration_control.description: Reduces atmospheric CO2 or greenhouse gas concentration
concentration_control.description_ja: 大気中CO2や温室効果ガス濃度を減らす

surface_cooling.label: Surface-cooling measure
surface_cooling.description: Reduces local surface or urban heating
surface_cooling.description_ja: 都市や地表面の局所加熱を減らす

stored_heat_pathway.label: Stored-heat pathway measure
stored_heat_pathway.description: Addresses the movement, dispersal, or circulation of heat already accumulated in oceans, land, and atmosphere
stored_heat_pathway.description_ja: 海洋・陸地・大気にすでに溜まった熱の移動・放散・循環経路を扱う

circulation_restoration.label: Circulation-restoration measure
circulation_restoration.description: Restores rain, ocean vertical circulation, soil-microbe cycles, and biological carbon fixation
circulation_restoration.description_ja: 雨、海洋鉛直循環、土壌微生物循環、生物的炭素固定を再接続する

integrated_restoration.label: Integrated restoration measure
integrated_restoration.description: Addresses input, stored heat, water cycle, ocean, soil, ecosystem, and civilization design as a connected system
integrated_restoration.description_ja: 入口、蓄積熱、水循環、海洋、土壌、生態系、文明設計を一つのつながったシステムとして扱う

scoring_axes.label: Future Heat Input Reduction
scoring_axes.description: Reduces future incoming heat or radiative forcing

scoring_axes.label: Existing Heat Release / Redistribution
scoring_axes.label_ja: 蓄積熱の放散・再分配
scoring_axes.description: Moves or disperses heat already stored in oceans, land, or urban surfaces into natural cooling pathways

scoring_axes.label: Thermal Inertia Response
scoring_axes.description: Responds to heat already committed by thermal inertia of oceans, soils, and urban mass

scoring_axes.label: Water Cycle Restoration
scoring_axes.description: Restores rainfall, cloud formation, evapotranspiration, and soil water retention

scoring_axes.label: Ocean Heat Pathway Restoration
scoring_axes.description: Restores ocean vertical circulation, nutrient supply, phytoplankton productivity, and sea-surface heat redistribution

scoring_axes.label: Soil-Microbe-Carbon Recovery
scoring_axes.label_ja: 土壌・微生物・炭素固定の回復
scoring_axes.description: Restores soil carbon, humus, microbial activity, and biological carbon fixation

scoring_axes.label: Ecosystem Regeneration
scoring_axes.description: Regenerates biodiversity, forests, marine ecosystems, and food-web integrity

scoring_axes.label: CO2 Reduction / Carbon Removal
scoring_axes.description: Reduces atmospheric CO2 concentration through removal or emission prevention

scoring_axes.label: Risk and Governance Burden
scoring_axes.label_ja: リスクとガバナンス負荷
scoring_axes.description: Side-effect risk, international governance difficulty, and control complexity (higher = more burdensome)

methods.name: Emissions Reduction
methods.short_description: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions through policy, technology transition, and behavior change
methods.short_description_ja: 政策・技術転換・行動変容による温室効果ガス削減
methods.notes: Essential foundation for any climate strategy. Reduces future forcing but does not address accumulated heat or degraded natural cycles.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Does not engage existing stored ocean heat, thermal inertia, or broken water/soil/ocean circulation systems.

methods.name: Renewable Energy Transition
methods.name_ja: 再生可能エネルギー転換
methods.short_description: Replacing fossil fuels with solar, wind, and other renewable sources
methods.short_description_ja: 化石燃料を太陽光・風力等の再生可能エネルギーへ転換
methods.notes: High technology readiness. Land use and mineral extraction trade-offs are real.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Addresses future emissions only. Does not restore natural cooling cycles or accumulated heat pathways.

methods.name: Energy Efficiency
methods.short_description: Reducing energy demand through improved buildings, industry, and transport
methods.short_description_ja: 建築・産業・交通の改善によるエネルギー需要削減
methods.notes: Lowest risk, highest technology readiness. Complementary to all other approaches.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Supplementary role only. Does not address any existing stored heat or natural cycle.

methods.name: Afforestation / Reforestation
methods.short_description: Planting trees on deforested or previously non-forested land
methods.short_description_ja: 裸地・伐採地への植林・再植林
methods.notes: Broad co-benefits. Effectiveness depends on species, location, and long-term fire and drought resilience.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Limited ocean heat pathway engagement. Vulnerable to climate-driven fire and drought feedback.

methods.name: Soil Carbon Sequestration
methods.short_description: Building soil carbon through agricultural and land management practices
methods.short_description_ja: 農業・土地管理実践による土壌炭素蓄積
methods.notes: Partial overlap with Soil-Microbe engine. Permanence and saturation limits remain open questions.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Does not address ocean heat or large-scale water cycle disruption.

methods.name: Biochar
methods.short_description: Pyrolysis of organic matter into stable charcoal applied to soil
methods.short_description_ja: 有機物の熱分解によって生成した安定炭素を土壌に施用
methods.notes: Long-term carbon stability is a strength. Net benefit depends on feedstock sourcing and production energy.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Does not address water cycle disruption, ocean heat, or thermal inertia.

methods.name: BECCS
methods.short_description: Bioenergy with carbon capture and geological storage
methods.short_description_ja: バイオエネルギー発電と炭素地中貯留の組み合わせ
methods.notes: Large land, water, and food-system competition. IPCC notes scale constraints.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Addresses only atmospheric concentration. Competes with land needed for ecosystem restoration.

methods.name: DACCS
methods.short_description: Direct air capture of atmospheric CO2 with geological storage
methods.short_description_ja: 大気中CO2の直接回収と地中貯留
methods.notes: Current capacity is many orders of magnitude below what would be needed at planetary scale. Energy-intensive.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Concentrates solely on CO2 removal. Does not address any natural cycle restoration or thermal inertia.

methods.name: Enhanced Weathering
methods.short_description: Spreading crushed silicate rocks to accelerate natural CO2 drawdown
methods.short_description_ja: 砕いたケイ酸塩岩を散布してCO2の自然吸収を促進
methods.notes: Potential soil pH and ocean chemistry co-benefits. Monitoring and scale-up remain challenging.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Does not address water cycle, thermal inertia, or direct ocean circulation restoration.

methods.name: Ocean Alkalinity Enhancement
methods.short_description: Adding alkaline materials to the ocean to increase CO2 absorption capacity
methods.short_description_ja: アルカリ性物質を海洋に添加してCO2吸収能力を高める
methods.notes: Marine ecosystem chemistry impacts are poorly understood at scale. High governance burden.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Modifies ocean chemistry but does not restore ocean vertical circulation or heat redistribution.

methods.name: Ocean Fertilization
methods.short_description: Adding iron or nutrients to ocean surface to stimulate phytoplankton growth
methods.short_description_ja: 鉄分等の栄養塩を海洋表層に添加して植物プランクトンを促進
methods.notes: Harmful algal bloom risk. Carbon export efficiency uncertain. Restricted under London Protocol.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Does not restore ocean vertical circulation structure. High risk of ecosystem disruption.

methods.name: Stratospheric Aerosol Injection
methods.name_ja: 成層圏エアロゾル散布
methods.short_description: Injecting reflective particles into the stratosphere to reduce incoming solar energy
methods.short_description_ja: 成層圏に反射性粒子を散布して太陽エネルギー入射を減らす
methods.notes: Fastest acting input-control. Does not remove CO2, does not restore natural cycles. Termination shock risk if stopped. May alter precipitation patterns regionally.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Entirely an input-control measure. Does not address accumulated ocean heat, CO2 concentration, or any natural circulation system. CO2 continues to rise. Ocean acidity unchanged.

methods.name: Marine Cloud Brightening
methods.short_description: Spraying sea salt into marine clouds to increase their reflectivity
methods.short_description_ja: 海塩粒子を海洋性雲に散布して反射率を高める
methods.notes: Regional precipitation changes possible. Does not address accumulated heat, CO2, or natural cycles.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Input-control only. No engagement with stored heat or natural cooling restoration.

methods.name: Cirrus Cloud Thinning
methods.short_description: Seeding cirrus clouds to allow more outgoing longwave radiation to escape
methods.short_description_ja: 巻雲に散布することで長波放射の大気圏外逃散を促す
methods.notes: Low technology readiness. Monitoring very difficult. No CO2 or circulation effect.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Radiation management only. No engagement with any natural cooling cycle.

methods.name: Surface Albedo Enhancement
methods.short_description: Increasing reflectivity of land surfaces through crops, materials, or land cover management
methods.short_description_ja: 作物・素材・土地被覆管理による地表反射率の向上
methods.notes: Modest and verifiable local effect. Planetary-scale impact limited.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Surface effect only. Does not engage any cooling cycle or stored heat pathway.

methods.name: Cool Roofs / Urban Albedo
methods.name_ja: クールルーフ・都市アルベド
methods.short_description: High-reflectivity roof and pavement materials to reduce urban heat island
methods.short_description_ja: 高反射率の屋根・舗装材による都市ヒートアイランド対策
methods.notes: Mature technology with verifiable local benefit. Does not address any planetary-scale cooling cycle.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Urban scale only. Does not restore water cycle, soil system, or ocean circulation.

methods.name: Radiative Cooling Materials
methods.short_description: Novel materials emitting infrared to the sky for passive surface cooling
methods.short_description_ja: 赤外線を天空に放射する素材による受動的冷却
methods.notes: Promising local technology. Planetary cooling impact is negligible.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Building and material scale only. No pathway to natural cycle restoration.

methods.name: Land-Rain Engine
methods.category_label_ja: マスターDPC/NCSフレームワーク
methods.short_description: Restoring soil water retention, vegetation, and evapotranspiration-driven latent heat cooling through rainfall cycle recovery
methods.short_description_ja: 土壌保水・植生・気化熱冷却を回復し、雨の循環を再起動する
methods.notes: Builds on existing restoration ecology and watershed management. The novel contribution is treating the full rainfall-soil-vegetation-cloud cycle as a single cooling engine.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Limited ocean heat engagement. Land-focused. Requires large-scale coordination across land-use systems.

methods.name: Ocean Vertical Circulation / Ocean Breathing System
methods.name_ja: 海洋鉛直循環・海洋呼吸システム
methods.category_label_ja: マスターDPC/NCSフレームワーク
methods.short_description: Assisted ocean vertical mixing, deep-sea aeration, and nanobubble oxygen supply to restore phytoplankton productivity and ocean heat redistribution
methods.short_description_ja: 深海曝気・ナノバブル酸素供給による海洋鉛直混合補助と植物プランクトン回復
methods.notes: Base technology (aquaculture aeration, nanobubbles) is proven. Ocean-basin scale extension is unproven. Harmful algal bloom risk requires rigorous monitoring as a precondition.
methods.missing_layer_gap: No direct engagement with land-based water cycle or soil-microbe systems. Requires careful HAB risk management.

methods.name: Soil-Microbe / Humus Engine
methods.name_ja: 土壌・微生物・腐葉土エンジン
methods.category_label_ja: マスターDPC/NCSフレームワーク
methods.short_description: Converting organic waste into humus to restore soil carbon, water retention, microbial diversity, and biological carbon fixation
methods.short_description_ja: 有機廃棄物を腐葉土化し、土壌炭素・保水力・微生物多様性・炭素固定を回復する
methods.notes: Key innovation: treating urban organic waste as a planetary cooling resource rather than a disposal problem. Pathogen control and contamination management are essential.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Does not address ocean heat pathway directly. Effectiveness at continental scale requires coordinated land and agriculture management.

methods.name: Urban Water Circulation and Mist Cooling
methods.name_ja: 都市水循環・ミスト冷却
methods.category_label_ja: マスターDPC/NCSフレームワーク
methods.short_description: Urban rainwater harvesting, green infrastructure, permeable surfaces, and ultrasonic mist to restore city water cycles and reduce heat island
methods.short_description_ja: 都市雨水回収・グリーンインフラ・透水面・超音波ミストによる都市水循環回復とヒートアイランド低減
methods.notes: Component technologies (rainwater harvesting, green roofs, mist systems) are mature. Integration at city scale is the novel contribution.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Urban-scale contribution. Does not directly engage ocean heat or large-scale soil-microbe restoration.

methods.name: Integrated Direct Planetary Cooling
methods.category_label_ja: マスターDPC/NCSフレームワーク
methods.short_description: Integrated deployment of Land-Rain Engine, Ocean Breathing System, and Soil-Microbe Engine as a planetary cooling cascade restoration framework
methods.short_description_ja: 陸・雨エンジン、海洋呼吸システム、土壌・微生物エンジンを統合した惑星冷却カスケード回復フレームワーク
methods.notes: Integrated restoration hypothesis. Individual components are partially tested. Full cross-system integration at planetary scale is unproven. The unique framing is treating water, ocean, soil, microbes, carbon, and heat as a single connected system.
methods.missing_layer_gap: Technology readiness of the integrated system is low. Monitoring cross-system interactions requires new methodologies. Not a replacement for emissions reduction.

methods.name: Integrated Natural Complementary Science
methods.category_label_ja: マスターDPC/NCSフレームワーク
methods.short_description: The full civilizational framework: DPC as physical restoration, Artificial Wisdom as governance intelligence, and Natural Law Civilization as long-term design
methods.short_description_ja: DPCを物理回復層、人工叡智をガバナンス知性、自然法則文明を長期設計とする文明規模の統合フレームワーク
methods.notes: Includes the governance and civilization design layer. The AI governance component reduces risk relative to DPC alone. This is the most comprehensive framework level — and therefore the most conceptually distant from current deployment.
methods.missing_layer_gap: The physical components require staged piloting and monitoring. The AI governance and civilization-design layers are conceptual frameworks at this stage.
